# Contributing to UI Vault

Thank you for your interest in contributing to UI Vault!

UI Vault is an open-source collection of UI designs made for developers.
Contributions from the community are welcome.

## What Can You Contribute?

You can contribute:

- Buttons
- Cards
- Alerts
- Forms
- Inputs
- Navigation components
- Hero sections
- Feature sections
- Pricing sections
- Footer sections
- Landing pages
- Dashboard designs
- Portfolio designs
- Complete page designs
- Improvements to existing designs
- Bug fixes
- Documentation improvements

## Before You Start

Please make sure that your contribution:

- Is your own work or something you have permission to distribute.
- Does not copy code from another project without permission.
- Does not copy a copyrighted design without permission.
- Does not contain malicious code.
- Works properly on different screen sizes.
- Follows the project's static HTML and CSS structure.
- Uses clean and accessible HTML markup.

## Adding a New Component or Page

To add a new component or page category:

1. Create a new folder matching your component type (e.g., `alerts/`).
2. Include an `index.html` and a `style.css` file inside that folder.
3. Link your stylesheet properly in the HTML `<head>`.
